description: Jersey Goods and Services Tax reference for the statutory snapshot checked in October 2026. Covers registration, ordinary returns, exempt and zero-rated classifications, partial exemption, input-credit restrictions, imported goods and services, records and personal import relief. Use for Jersey GST, deductible input tax, mixed supplies, prescription supplies, exports or customs valuation. Separates tax classification from international-services relief and customs duties. Examples use established classifications and explicit assumptions. Unresolved attribution directions, percentage rounding, specialist schemes and tariff conditions require further verification before calculations. This source-cited draft awaits professional review and is incomplete as an operational companion.
